source.note: Full text of ASME BPVC Section II, Part B (Nonferrous Material Specifications) — SB-625 - Specification for UNS N08925, UNS N08031, UNS N08034, UNS N08932, UNS N08926, UNS N08354, UNS N08830, and UNS R20033 Plate, Sheet, and Strip — as supplied by Daniel Velasquez on 2026-09-07 and extracted from the supplied PDF with marker-pdf. `data` is the extractor's output verbatim — the drop's own `document`, `part`, `figures` and `pages` blocks, with the page-by-page block tree, its HTML, tables and layout coordinates unedited. This file IS the source document, so `transcribed_from` names its own path: it is the artefact under review, not a transcription of one. The volume was supplied as one combined PDF and cut into parts at its own headings, so this file is a page-range slice of a single extraction and its page ids (PDF pages None–None, no printed page numbers on these pages) are the combined document's own, not renumbered from 0. Front matter (cover and title page, contents, list of sections, foreword, statement of policy, personnel, correspondence, summary of changes, cross-referencing) and back matter (back cover) were deleted from the drop before supply and are NOT filed; the drop's `content.json`, `index.json`, `meta.json` and `README.md` are retained beside the kind folders, unfiled, for the same reason. The edition — 2025 Edition (ASME BPVC.II.B-2025), issued 2025-07-01 — is stated on the title page, which this drop no longer carries as a filed cut: it survives only inside the retained `content.json`, so no filed cut of this standard prints its own edition. This cut carries no figure.

children.html: SPECIFICATION FOR UNS N08925, UNS N08031, UNS N08034, UNS N08932, UNS N08926, UNS N08354, UNS N08830, AND UNS R20033 PLATE, SHEET, AND STRIP
(Identical with ASTM Specification B625-17 except that certification and test reports have been made mandatory, and heat treatment requirements for UNS N08354 have been added.)
ASME SB-625 replaces 5.1.9 of ASTM B625, adds paras. 6 and 6.1, and redesignates former paras. 6 through 9.1 as 7 through 10.1, as follows:
5.1.9 Certification or test reports—Certification and test reports are required, and
6.1 UNS N08354 shall be furnished in the solution annealed condition at a temperature range from 1975°F to 2155°F (1080°C to 1180°C) followed by rapid cooling in air or water.
7.1 The material shall conform to the composition limits specified in Table 1. One test per lot is required as defined in Specification B906.
7.2 If a product analysis is made by the purchaser, the material shall conform to the product (check) analysis variations in Specification B906.
8.1 Tensile and Hardness Requirements—The material shall conform to the mechanical property requirements specified in Table 2. One test per lot is required as defined in Specification B906.
9.1 Sheet—The material shall be furnished in accordance with the dimensional requirements established in Specification B906.

Standard Specification for UNS N08925, UNS N08031, UNS N08034, UNS N08932, UNS N08926, UNS N08354, UNS N08830, and UNS R20033 Plate, Sheet, and Strip1

This standard is issued under the fixed designation B625; the number immediately following the designation indicates the year of original adoption or, in the case of revision, the year of last revision. A number in parentheses indicates the year of last reapproval. A superscript epsilon (´) indicates an editorial change since the last revision or reapproval.
1.1 This specification covers alloys UNS N08925, UNS N08031, UNS N08034, UNS N08932, UNS N08926, UNS N08354, UNS N08830, and UNS R20033 plate, sheet, and strip in the annealed temper.

1.2 ASTM International has adopted definitions whereby some grades, such as UNS N08904, previously in this specification were recognized as stainless steels, because those grades have iron as the largest element by mass percent. Such grades are under the oversight of ASTM Committee A01 and its subcommittees. The products of N08904 previously covered in this specification are now covered by Specifications A240/ A240M and A480/A480M.

1.3 The values stated in inch-pound units are to be regarded as standard. The values given in parentheses are mathematical conversions to SI units that are provided for information only and are not considered standard.

1.4 This standard does not purport to address all of the safety concerns, if any, associated with its use. It is the responsibility of the user of this standard to become familiar with all hazards including those identified in the appropriate Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for this product/material as provided by the manufacturer, to establish appropriate safety, health and environmental practices, and determine the applicability of regulatory limitations prior to use.

1.5 This international standard was developed in accordance with internationally recognized principles on standardization established in the Decision on Principles for the Development of International Standards, Guides and Recommendations issued by the World Trade Organization Technical Barriers to Trade (TBT) Committee.

3.1 Definitions of Terms Specific to This Standard:
3.1.1 plate, n—material 3⁄16 in. (4.76 mm) and over in thickness and over 10 in. (254 mm) in width.
3.1.2 sheet, n—material under 3⁄16 in. (4.76 mm) in thickness and 24 in. (609.6 mm) and over in width. Material under 3⁄16 in. (4.75 mm) in thickness and in all widths with No. 4 finish.
3.1.3 strip, n—material under 3⁄16 in. (4.76 mm) in thickness and under 24 in. (609.6 mm) in width.
4.1 Material furnished in accordance with this specification shall conform to the applicable requirements of the current edition of Specification B906 unless otherwise provided herein.

Committee B02 has identified the location of selected changes to this standard since the last issue (B625–14) that may impact the use of this standard. (Approved July 1, 2017.)
• (1) Changed the title to include new alloy.
• (2) Added new alloy UNS N08034 to scope (Section 1).
• (3) Added chemistry data for UNS N08034 to Table 1.
• (4) Added Mechanical property data to Table 2 for UNS N08034.
